name: In Service of Zephras
label: Quest

intro: In Service of Zephras is a quest in which an adventurer carries word from the High Order pledging their full military and diplomatic support to Valanaar against the Al'Aketh cult. Escalating hostile movements across the island have forced the High Order to abandon their policy of avoiding direct confrontation with the cultists. Upon delivering the message to Valennia Stormfist, the envoy also brings grim news regarding the death of her cousin Belathaan, solidifying a joint resolve to protect the people of Zephras.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.
Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am sorry to hear about Belathaan. He was actually my cousin and he was a good adventurer and servant of Zephras. We will avenge him.
You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.
